carry_forward_verification.QA-009: Resolved. In tests/support/deadline.rs, stdin is written on a detached thread. Each pipe wait is bounded by PIPE_GRACE, after which the process group is killed (kill -KILL -- -pgid) and the captured bytes are returned without joining the reader thread. Unit tests cover all three cases. A 4 MiB unread stdin does not block (unread_stdin_does_not_block). A pipe-holding grandchild is bounded by the grace (grandchild_holding_the_pipe_is_bounded_by_the_grace). A deadline kill with a grandchild returns promptly (deadline_kill_returns_despite_a_grandchild).

carry_forward_verification.QA-011: Resolved. The key now hashes untracked non-ignored files (path and contents) as well as the HEAD tree and the working diff.
